_: The domain grid, and what a correct route looks like on every square of it.
Read by `evals/route/tool_usage.py`. Four axes - format, pillar, source, focus -
and the two generation phases, which is 240 combinations. Every one of them
is a real run the interface can produce, so every one of them is a case.
WHAT THIS FILE OWNS, AND WHAT IT DELIBERATELY DOES NOT.
The method has two tables, and the skill bodies present them as two:
`dezvolta-postarea` Pasul 3 says which references a FORMAT needs, and
`propune-postari` Pasul 4 says which reference and which tool a SOURCE
needs. The format half is already written down, in `references.json`, per
scenario, with `forbidden` and everything - so it is read from there and
not copied here. This file holds only the source half, plus the axes and
the skill each phase must open. Two files, two tables, no third copy.
`propune-postari/carti.md` is the one reference that belongs to the source
half rather than the format half, which is why `references.json` leaves it
with no `titluri` or `detalii-*` expectation at all. Its row is below.
PHASE 2 AND THE SHELF. `dezvolta-postarea/SKILL.md` says to call
`search_books` for Carti, and it never names `carti.md` - the file lives in
the other skill's folder and nothing sends the model there. So in `detalii`
the shelf is neither required nor forbidden: the method does not say, and an
eval that invents an expectation the method never wrote is measuring itself.
COMBINAT IS HONESTLY VAGUE. The form offers one button, and the skill says
'doar ale surselor alese de ea' - which sources those are is a thing the
form never asked. So the label is `any_of`: at least one of the two search
tools, neither of them forbidden. Tightening this needs a form change, not a
sharper eval.

titluri.what: Faza 1 — cele zece propuneri. Un buton „Generare", o dată pe lot.

detalii.what: Faza 2 — cele cinci variante ale unei idei. O dată pentru fiecare idee deschisă.

Memorie.why: „La Memorie, deci, faza asta se termină cu un singur fișier citit: SKILL.md." Raftul deschis în afara rândului tău e material din care n-ai voie să iei.

Cărți.why: Raftul a intrat în corpul skill-ului pe 2026-08-28, deci sursa nu mai deschide niciun fișier - decide numai unealta. `search_books` la Cărți, de fiecare dată, în ambele faze.

Internet.why: Rândul Internet din tabel cere unealta și nicio referință. „La Memorie și la Internet nu-l deschizi deloc."

Combinat.why: „Doar ale surselor alese de ea" — și formularul nu a întrebat care. Cel puțin una din două, niciuna interzisă.
